_description: Music, sounds and effects volume. 'music': each track uses EITHER 'synth' (a built-in melody in src/game/audio/songs/: "picnic" = upbeat and cozy, "meadow" = slow and warm, "overcast" = slow, gray and wistful, "haze" = sparse and hazy) OR 'file' (an mp3/ogg inside public/, e.g. "assets/audio/title.mp3"); 'volume' is 0 to 1. 'sounds': recordings used by the game (e.g. the data center noise), each with EITHER 'synth' (built-in, see src/game/audio/recordings/: "datacenter" = fans, electrical buzz and high whine; "construction" = engine, reversing beeper, hammers, jackhammer) OR 'file' (a real recording, e.g. "assets/audio/datacenter.mp3"). 'sfxVolume' (0 to 1) = small sound effects (pop-up chimes, footsteps); 0 turns them off. 'alexCoughSeconds' = [min, max]: Alex coughs at a random moment in that range, again and again, while on the map ([0, 0] turns it off).
_usedIn: Simulation page → Start screen, Title screen, Intro slides, the valley (music, data center noise, sound effects)

title._location: Starts after the first click ('Click anywhere to begin') and plays on the opening page.

intro._location: Intro slides (the title music crossfades into this). Fades out at '6 months later'.

valley._location: The valley (game map), set by maps/valley.json → music

datacenter._location: The noise pop-up's player and the background hum near the data center

construction._location: Intro slide 3 (construction): replaces the music for that slide
